construction: Rank a universe by prior return; long winners and short losers, commonly quantile portfolios.
typical_horizon: 3-12 months formation and roughly 3-12 months holding
notes: Canonical Jegadeesh-Titman family; results depend on universe, weighting, skip period, costs and rebalance design.

construction: Rank on trailing 12-month return while omitting the most recent month.
notes: A common academic implementation intended to reduce short-horizon reversal contamination.

construction: Rank on approximately six-month prior return, often with a one-month skip in academic variants.
notes: Frequent alternative to 12-1; exact construction is not universal.

construction: For each asset, take exposure from the sign of its own past excess return rather than cross-sectional rank.
literature_status: Strong evidence in diversified futures; equity-specific scope differs
notes: Not the same construct as stock cross-sectional momentum.

construction: Rank factor-adjusted or residual returns rather than raw returns.
notes: Designed to separate raw momentum from common factor exposures; requires a factor model.

construction: Rank industries or use industry-relative returns.

notes: Common in index methodologies; not identical to canonical academic winner-minus-loser portfolios.
